<section id="bootstrapping-a-new-repository">
<h1>Bootstrapping a new repository</h1>
<!-- docledger-section: bootstrap-why-the-first-scan-is-a-baseline -->
<section id="why-the-first-scan-is-a-baseline">
<h2>Why the first scan is a baseline</h2>
<p>The first scan establishes a baseline. It records evidence hashes, memory hashes, evidence inventory, and file lists, but it does not report changed, deleted, stale, or unlinked evidence because there is no previous scan to compare against. Later scans compare the current state with the baseline and report deltas.</p>
<p>This design means the first scan is always clean. You can commit the baseline immediately without reviewing stale memory, then use later scans to drive incremental updates.</p>
<!-- docledger-section: bootstrap-setup-sequence -->
</section>
<section id="setup-sequence">
<h2>Setup sequence</h2>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger init</span></code> from the repository root to create the canonical <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/</span></code> layout.</p></li>
<li><p>Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger --json scan</span></code> to record the baseline.</p></li>
<li><p>Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger --json status</span></code> to confirm the workspace is in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">incremental_clean</span></code> state.</p></li>
<li><p>Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger memory render-context --bootstrap --out /tmp/memledger-bootstrap.md</span></code> to generate the bootstrap context.</p></li>
<li><p>Use the bootstrap context to create initial memory entries and establish the link graph.</p></li>
<li><p>Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger links import-map --file /tmp/memledger-map.yaml --validate</span></code> to validate and apply the initial links.</p></li>
<li><p>Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger --json scan</span></code> again to record the new baseline with links.</p></li>
<li><p>Commit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/ledger.toml</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/memoryledger/config.toml</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/memoryledger/data/storage.yaml</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/memoryledger/data/scan.yaml</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/memoryledger/data/memory/*.yaml</span></code>.</p></li>
</ol>
<p>After this initial setup, subsequent scans will report deltas and the incremental workflow begins.</p>
</section>
